FGOCORE-HOLY_GRAIL_RITUAL.title: A Vessel Beyond Limits
A golden chalice rests before you, brimming with power enough to surpass the limits of a Servant. It asks for neither blood nor a wish—only a worthy offering.
The vessel remains silent. Your offering is insufficient.
Some limits exist for a reason.
The offering vanishes in golden light. The Grail answers, reshaping your Saint Graph beyond its former limits.
FGOCORE-HOLY_GRAIL_RITUAL.pages.DECLINED: You turn away. The golden light fades without protest.
FGOCORE-HOLY_GRAIL_RITUAL.pages.UNAVAILA: The ritual can no longer be completed. The Grail's light recedes.
